# Companions - Widget Pets

> Companions is a free iPhone app that puts a little animated aquarium in a Home Screen widget. You pick your fish from 58 hand-drawn species, name them, and they swim on your Home Screen, in StandBy, on your Mac desktop and on Apple Watch. Nothing needs feeding and nothing can die. Made by Tiaan van der Riel and Shea in South Korea. App Store ID 6811950512, iOS 26.0 or later, current version 4.5 (November 4, 2026).

Key facts:
- Free download with eight fish (Tang, Sardine, Puffer, Neon, Guppy, Goldfish, Angelfish, Betta). Other fish come in 10 packs of five, each a one-time in-app purchase, or all at once with "All Fish" (lifetime purchase or monthly plan).
- Widgets in small, medium and large; each size keeps its own set of up to five fish. The fish animate continuously in the widget without the app running.
- Eight tank styles: Minimal, Twilight, Pond, Reed, Blossom, Dark, Pumpkin, Lavender. 19 props to arrange. Multiple tanks per size ("My Tanks"), 18 ready-made tanks ("Explore").
- Complications in a tank corner: time, date, weather, step goal, Moon phase (included with All Fish).
- Works in StandBy, on iPad, on Apple Watch (watch app shows the small tank), and on Mac via iPhone widgets on Mac. No Lock Screen widget.
- No account, no ads, no tracking. Anonymous usage statistics can be switched off. Translated into 12 languages.
- Support: companionswidgetpets@gmail.com
- Languages: the site is written in English (https://companionswidgetpets.github.io/), German (https://companionswidgetpets.github.io/de/), Spanish (https://companionswidgetpets.github.io/es/), French (https://companionswidgetpets.github.io/fr/), Portuguese (https://companionswidgetpets.github.io/pt/), Russian (https://companionswidgetpets.github.io/ru/), Japanese (https://companionswidgetpets.github.io/ja/), Korean (https://companionswidgetpets.github.io/ko/), Simplified Chinese (https://companionswidgetpets.github.io/zh-hans/) and Traditional Chinese (https://companionswidgetpets.github.io/zh-hant/); every page has the same address in each language after the language's folder.
